title: Transformer-Enabled Diachronic Analysis of Vedic Sanskrit: Neural Methods for Quantifying Types of Language Change
reasoning: The paper conducts a linguistic analysis of the diachronic evolution of Sanskrit using a corpus of religious and philosophical texts (such as the Rigveda and Upanishads). While it tracks the evolution of religious and philosophical terminology as a linguistic feature, the study's goal is to quantify morphological complexity and language change rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious beliefs, ethics, or morals.
